# Terrain · Cedwyn Estate in 3D

> A live 3D landscape of the Cedwyn Estate and Great House Farm (Tŷ Mawr), Llandough: every Great House Farm site is a building on the path, with the farmhouse, barn, fields, pond and St Dochdwy's churchyard to the south. The owner edits it by voice; visitors can look around, open the Roadmap layer and ask by voice what is due or where a trail stands.

## How we treat outside records

This archive is the chronology and central record of Tŷ Mawr (Great House Farm), Llandough-juxta-Penarth. Tŷ Mawr is first named in the record we have found in David Stewart’s 1824 survey of the Bute Glamorgan estates (EV-0211). The Williams family acquired Tŷ Mawr in 1667 (sources: Mary Williams’ statement in the 1974 newspapers; ITV News, 1988). Bute estate and other third-party documents dated before 1824 (the Cydwin lease, Bute catalogue headings such as NLW D 219) are not records of Tŷ Mawr; their application to it is under forensic examination, and the Bute freeholds are under forensic examination for validity. Outside narratives are tested against these records, not repeated. Every name of the house, town and estate: /ebooks/enwau/. Method: /values/#outside-records

## Pages
- [Terrain](https://terrain.bucklerfamily.estate/): the 3D scene (orbit, zoom, walk; tap a building to open its site).

## Data (read-only JSON)
- [Current scene](https://terrain.bucklerfamily.estate/agent/scene.json): every object (id, name, kind, position, colour, link) plus time of day and weather.
- [Saved versions](https://terrain.bucklerfamily.estate/agent/versions.json): names and dates of saved versions.
- [Roadmap](https://terrain.bucklerfamily.estate/agent/roadmap.json): one disclosure trail per institution, eleven steps each from request to court, with status and date.
- [Trigger-event procedure](https://terrain.bucklerfamily.estate/agent/sop.json): the branching steps, gates, routes and outcomes.
- [Due](https://terrain.bucklerfamily.estate/agent/due.json?days=7): steps falling due in the next N days.
- [Published changes](https://github.com/unclehowell/terrain/commits/main/data/scene.json): each editing session committed to data/scene.json.
- [Tools](https://terrain.bucklerfamily.estate/agent/tools.json): the read-only WebMCP tools this site registers.
